title: Riyad as-Salihin: Gardens of the Righteous
description: Study Riyad as-Salihin (Gardens of the Righteous), compiled by Imam Muhyi ad-Din Abu Zakariyya Yahya ibn Sharaf an-Nawawi (1233-1277 CE). This renowned collection focuses on moral teachings and spiritual practices, drawing hadiths primarily from the two most authentic sources: Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim. Imam an-Nawawi organized the hadiths into topical chapters covering matters of worship, ethics, and spiritual purification, making it one of the most widely read hadith collections in the Muslim world.
